text:
maria: Heads-up — Acme onboarding bumped. They need 16 A100s in us-west2 for inference (low-latency) starting Mon. Can we hit that?
capacity-bot: Reservation request #8421 received. Region: us-west2. Current cluster free GPUs: 4. Queue position: 4. See /capacity for details.
samir: Start date = Mon 03/30? that gives us ~5 days. With current queue we won't be able to fully provision in time unless we reassign.
maria: correct — onboarding call scheduled Mon afternoon. customer expects production-ready by end of week.
kevin: Current pending reservations ahead: 3. Typical provisioning path = bake image + attach to dedicated pool + networking changes -> ~7–10 business days. If we reassign from dev we can do ~48–72h but that requires manual ops and CI degradation.
ryan: Could we split the request: 8 dedicated + 8 burst preemptible? That buys us runway while vendor order completes.
samir: yes — technical tradeoff: preemptible instances risk interruptions but for initial phase we can make them redundant and checkpoint. Cost-wise ~30% cheaper.
julia: Finance here — need rough cost delta between 1yr reserved commitment vs short-term on-demand + burst. Post a quick TCO please.
samir: rough numbers (very rough):
```
1yr reserved A100 (per GPU): $2,100/mo
On-demand A100 (per GPU): $3,200/mo
Preemptible A100 (per GPU): $2,200/mo
```
So 16 GPUs reserved 1yr = $33.6k/mo; on-demand = $51.2k/mo. Short-term mixed approach ~ $38–40k/mo for month-1.
maria: ok finance sign-off pending but customer prefers single-region us-west2 for latency.
kevin: other option: provision 12 A100s in us-central immediately (we have headroom) and route traffic via smart-routing for user region — adds ~60–90ms P50, but tail depends on network.
ryan: low-latency SLA for Acme is 100ms P95. us-central might push close to limit for some customers in west coast; need real traffic test.
samir: I'll try urgent quota bump with vendor: escalation note sent to account rep. They said ETA 48–72h if they have inventory.
maria: if we do 8 dedicated (from dev reclaim) + 8 preemptible, what's ops work? @kevin
kevin: reclaiming 8 GPUs from CI: ~2h to resize pools + 1h to update CI workers; also need to communicate to platform team. Then image + network apply ~3h. Total ~6h. Risk: longer CI queues, but acceptable short-term.
julia: finance approves temporary spend up to $45k for the month if it avoids missing onboarding milestone.
maria: good — proceed with hybrid plan. samir please create the formal reservation ticket and tag escalation. also add routing runbook changes if we end up cross-region.
samir: created ticket: https://tickets.internal/8421 — added labels: urgent, acme-onboarding, hybrid. Assigning to kevin for ops work. :white_check_mark:
capacity-bot: Reservation #8421 moved to escalations. Vendor contact notified. ETA: vendor quote in 2 business days, provisional capacity allocated: 8 preemptible.
kevin: taking ownership of ops tasks. Will start reclaim and image bake window at 22:00 PST tonight to minimize impact.
maria: thanks all. please post a short status update in this thread after the reclaim and when vendor confirms ETA. :thumbsup:
samir: escalation email thread created and cc'd finance + sales. I'll follow up with vendor for faster delivery.
kevin: reclaim started — removing 8 GPUs from ci-pool now. CI will be throttled for ~24h. Will post logs if anything breaks.
maria: noted. ping me if vendor confirms earlier delivery; we can convert preemptible -> dedicated.
samir: vendor replied: possible partial shipment 5 days, full fulfillment 12–15 days. Putting formal quote in ticket.
julia: finance OK with converting to 1yr reserve if we see steady usage after month 1 — pre-approval workflow needed.
ryan: also flagging network egress cost if we go cross-region — might add ~$2k–5k/month depending on traffic. Keep that in mind.
kevin: reclaim finished. 8 GPUs live in us-west2 dedicated pool. Baking image now. ETA deployment complete: +3h.
maria: excellent — keeping customer updated. Will close loop once onboarding is green.
